_meta.note: Audit for free historical exact-score calibration sources. A source is accepted only if it provides reproducible, free, pre-match exact-score snapshots suitable for 2018/2022 World Cup backtests.

decision.recommendation: Use Bwin exact-score as a manual watch/disagreement signal only. Do not blend it into scoreline probabilities until a free historical exact-score snapshot dataset can be backtested against 2018/2022 or a later complete tournament.
requirements: free/no paid API/no credit-card trial/no paywall
World Cup 2018/2022 coverage or enough comparable tournament coverage
match-level mapping to the local fixture ids

sources.name: Bwin.de current CDS fixture-view
sources.result: Accepted for current 2026 watch snapshots, rejected for calibration because no free 2018/2022 historical Bwin exact-score snapshot archive was found.

sources.name: OddsPortal archived results
sources.result: Rejected for this repo step: archived odds are visible in an interactive site, but no free, stable, repo-reproducible Bwin exact-score snapshot export for the 2018/2022 World Cup backtests was accepted.

sources.name: Football-Data.co.uk free CSV archive
sources.result: Useful free machine-readable historical results and 1X2/over-under/handicap odds, but no exact-score price grid for the required World Cup calibration.

sources.name: The Odds API historical odds
sources.result: Rejected by project constraints because historical odds snapshots are only available on paid usage plans.

sources.name: Betfair Historical Data
sources.result: Rejected for the local no-friction workflow: access depends on a registered Betfair account/historical-data service and was not accepted as a free reproducible source for 2018/2022 exact-score calibration.

sources.name: OddsPapi historical odds
sources.result: Not accepted for this calibration pass: public material advertises historical odds, but no validated free 2018/2022 World Cup exact-score snapshot dataset was found.
